scenarios.name: Reserva simple presencial
assertions: availability consulted
one Bookings Writer V2 create
one confirmation
one CitasF2 projection
idempotent replay creates no duplicate

scenarios.name: Disponibilidad dual con gap exacto y mismo profesional
assertions: exact exposure interval
same staff resource
customer-facing 30-minute visible subset returned
no raw slot inventory or dual pair snapshot persisted
shorter or longer gap rejected

scenarios.name: Reserva dual: dos bookings independientes y dos proyecciones CMS vinculadas
scenarios.limitation: Wix Bookings Writer y CMS se simulan offline. No certifica disponibilidad concurrente ni escritura real en el sitio publicado.
assertions: query native F1 and F2 availability independently
create two independent Bookings V2 appointments
persist two CitasF2 rows with shared pairToken
confirm both native bookings
keep F2 native availability validation enabled

scenarios.name: Compensación LIFO al fallar F2
assertions: F2 Writer failure cancels previously created F1
partial CitasF2 insert is marked CANCELLED and compensated
both native bookings are cancelled after partial CMS persistence
original saga failure is preserved
compensation is followed by lock release
scenarios.limitation: La saga y la llamada de cancelación se prueban con Writer V2/CMS simulados offline. Falta E2E contra un entorno Wix de QA con Writer real.

scenarios.name: Reconciliación segura de resultado incierto de Bookings Writer
assertions: one SIMPLE CitasF2 projection resolves using its native bookingId
exact DUAL_F1 and DUAL_F2 projections resolve using native bookingIds
no projection never proves that Wix did not create a booking
partial dual projection is retained for manual repair
ambiguous outcomes never transition to FAILED_FINAL
ambiguous outcomes create a deduplicated operational alert
scenarios.limitation: The test simulates CMS projections and transaction records. It does not query the live Wix Bookings Writer after a network timeout; ambiguous results are intentionally held for manual reconciliation.

scenarios.name: Preparación de checkout sin pago
assertions: create cart from booking ID
calculate cart
reject violations and mismatched response
checkout URL retrieved only after valid calculation
scenarios.limitation: No payment provider transaction or successful paid-order webhook is simulated by this fixture.

scenarios.name: Pago Wix Payments confirmado: webhook oficial, ledger append-only y reserva dual
assertions: read the official Wix event id from metadata.id
read data.order and use priceSummary.totalPrice.amount as the authoritative order total
append exactly one MovimientosCaja movement with paymentMethod WIX_PAYMENTS and movementType VENTA_ONLINE
persist linked booking ids and an event idempotency marker in ControlOperativo
mark both CitasF2 rows PAID while preserving bookingStatus PENDING
same-event replay is ignored
new event id for the same order does not append a second fiscal movement
scenarios.limitation: Offline test uses Wix event-shaped fixtures and mocked Wix Data only. It does not initiate a Wix Payments transaction, validate account activation, invoke the live Wix webhook runtime, or write to production CMS.

scenarios.name: Cancelación y repetición de webhook
assertions: CitasF2 updated before webhook marker
missing projection fails closed
read errors propagate
replay reconciles stale projection

scenarios.name: Identidad, permisos y fichaje
assertions: member-contact-staff identity linked
role guards enforced
signed clock record persisted
signature verifies and tampering fails
history consumes persisted record

scenarios.name: Venta presencial, caja y cierre Z
assertions: manual transaction persists
cash projection updates
close Z created
hash-chain integrity verified
scenarios.limitation: The signer is a local mock. No real certificate, AEAT submission or fiscal compliance is established.

scenarios.name: Resolución de total de pedido
assertions: explicit order total takes precedence
zero total preserved
fallback total validated

scenarios.name: Automatizaciones y entrega de notificaciones
assertions: one customer confirmation
one staff notification
cancel and reschedule templates
delivery evidence captured
scenarios.limitation: Wix Automations configuration and actual delivery are not covered by offline backend mocks.

scenarios.name: Formulario, CRM, opt-in y baja
assertions: contact request reaches CRM
marketing opt-in is separate
unsubscribe persists and suppresses further sends
scenarios.limitation: Public form delivery, Wix Contacts and Automations are not exercised in this offline suite.

scenarios.name: Reprogramación completa
assertions: old slot released
new slot reserved
dual pair remains consistent
customer and staff notifications sent
scenarios.limitation: No end-to-end reschedule scenario has been evidenced.

scenarios.name: Gift Card / bono
assertions: issue
redeem partially
prevent over-redemption
refund and reconcile balance
scenarios.limitation: No Gift Card issue/redeem integration test has been evidenced.

scenarios.name: Devoluciones y reembolsos con cadena fiscal facsímil
assertions: all supported refund movement types create a RECTIFICATIVA event
accountingSign is -1 and accountingAmount is negative
cash projection reduces the seeded synthetic opening balance
movement id is applied exactly once to CajaActual
hash chain integrity reports zero breaks
concept contains the exact simulation label
scenarios.limitation: Only offline Wix Data mocks and a mock signer are used. No real X.509 signature, AEAT transmission, payment, CMS mutation or fiscal validity is established.

scenarios.name: Serie, hash encadenado y firma ficticia FACSIMIL
assertions: global and annual synthetic sequence values form a FACSIMIL series
each FACSIMIL hash chains to the previous FACSIMIL hash
signature-shaped placeholder is explicitly NOT-X509
canonical payload tampering invalidates verification
real hexadecimal chain hashes are rejected as previous FACSIMIL hashes
AEAT submission and verification QR remain disabled
scenarios.limitation: This isolated helper is not connected to registerManualTransaction or production CMS. It does not create a legal invoice, X.509 signature or AEAT-valid hash.

scenarios.name: Matriz determinista de resultados PSP y fallo de preflight del ledger
assertions: pending and failed provider outcomes never append a sale movement
pending and failed outcomes never mark CitasF2 as PAID
a failed strong read of MovimientosCaja propagates and does not masquerade as an empty ledger
failed webhook claim remains retryable
no payment provider call or CMS runtime write

scenarios.name: Contrato del agente externo no configurado
assertions: agent returns AI_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED
no fabricated provider output is returned
traceId is preserved when valid
no external transport or secret lookup is invoked
scenarios.limitation: The current repository has no configured external AI provider adapter. This test verifies the fail-closed contract; it does not simulate a real provider response or an agent automation.

scenarios.name: Evento ORDER_CREATED de Wix Stores y conciliación de catálogos
assertions: ORDER_CREATED event persists one idempotency marker
duplicate ORDER_CREATED delivery is ignored
native order reconciler covers Bookings, Stores and mixed catalog references
incomplete catalog references are sent to review instead of inventing a product identity
custom MovimientosInventario and InventarioStockVenta remain untouched
scenarios.limitation: Only event marker and scheduled order reconciliation are tested with mocks. No product checkout, PSP payment, native stock decrement or refund/restock is executed.

scenarios.name: Compra de producto físico, pago y stock nativo Wix Stores
assertions: physical product checkout completes with a PSP sandbox method
one native order is created and paid
native Wix Stores inventory decrements exactly once
cancel/refund restores stock exactly once
webhook and order reconciliation remain idempotent
no custom inventory or fiscal movement is duplicated
scenarios.limitation: No isolated Wix QA site or verified PSP sandbox is available. The Published site must not be used for synthetic product purchases or refunds.

scenarios.name: Reserva online con checkout y resultado PSP real de sandbox
assertions: online booking is created and projected once
Cart V2 calculates the authoritative amount
sandbox PSP success, failure and timeout outcomes are handled
official payment webhook updates payment without incorrectly confirming booking state
one fiscal ledger movement is appended for a confirmed payment
duplicate webhook delivery creates no second ledger movement
scenarios.limitation: Current tests mock the Wix event envelope and CMS only. No isolated Wix runtime or PSP sandbox transaction has been executed.

scenarios.name: Resolución de ruta dinámica Wix con sufijo numérico
assertions: exact canonical slug lookup retains priority
numeric Wix dynamic-page suffix resolves only to a unique canonical CMS slug
duplicate canonical slug candidates return SERVICE_LOOKUP_AMBIGUOUS
no CMS record or dynamic-page URL is rewritten
scenarios.limitation: This verifies the backend resolver with mocks. It does not prove the Wix Editor dynamic item page is published or that the browser route renders in Wix Runtime.

scenarios.name: Reserva confirmada sin recurso ni identidad explícita de profesional
assertions: NO_SELECTION is not interpreted as a customer instruction to choose no professional
without BookedResource or explicit staffMemberId mapping, no staff resource is inferred
unassigned native booking contributes no minutes to an individual staff workload
projection remains in review and no CitasF2 row is created
scenarios.limitation: The scenario is offline mock coverage. It does not assign a professional to existing live bookings or validate a live Wix booking flow.
